WITH per_type_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    e.type,
    AVG(CASE WHEN b.amount > 0 THEN b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio
  FROM budget b 
  JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id 
  WHERE b.spent > 0 AND b.amount > 0 
  GROUP BY e.type
),
mean_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_mean
  FROM per_type_ratios
)
SELECT 
  ptr.type,
  ROUND(ptr.avg_ratio, 4) as avg_spend_ratio,
  ROUND(ptr.avg_ratio - mr.overall_mean, 4) as deviation_from_mean
FROM per_type_ratios ptr
CROSS JOIN mean_ratio mr
ORDER BY ptr.type
